d: If you jab someone, you push them suddenly and hard with your finger or a tool.
A jab is a sudden, sharp punch or poke.
If you jabber, you talk very quickly and excitedly so that it is hard to understand.
A jack is a heavy metal tool used for lifting a car off the ground.
A jackal is a wild animal that looks like a dog and lives in Africa and Asia.
A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves that you wear to keep warm.
A jackpot is the largest cash prize you can win in a game or lottery.
Jade is a hard, precious green stone used for making jewelry and art.
If something is jagged, it has rough, uneven, and sharp edges.
A jaguar is a large, wild cat with a yellow coat and black spots.
A jail is a secure building where criminals are kept locked up.
If someone is jailed, they are sent to a prison as a punishment.
A jalapeno is a small, dark green pepper that tastes extremely hot.
Jam is a sweet, sticky food made by boiling fruit and sugar together.
If a machine jams, its moving parts get stuck and it stops working.
A janitor is a person whose job is to clean and take care of a large building.
January is the first month of the year in the Western calendar.
A jar is a glass container with a lid, used for storing food like honey or jam.
Jargon refers to the difficult, specialized words used by professionals in a specific job.
Jasmine is a climbing plant that produces small white flowers with a sweet smell.
A javelin is a long spear that athletes try to throw as far as possible in a competition.
Your jaw is the bone in the lower part of your face that holds your teeth.
Jazz is a style of music invented by African Americans, known for its strong rhythms.
If you are jealous, you feel angry because someone else has something that you want.
Jealousy is the unhappy feeling of wanting what someone else has.
Jeans are casual pants made from thick blue cotton cloth called denim.
A jeep is a strong, open car designed for driving over rough dirt roads.
Jelly is a soft, sweet food made from fruit juice and gelatin that shakes when you move it.
A jellyfish is a sea creature with a clear, soft body and long stinging tentacles.
A jerk is a sudden, sharp physical movement.
If you jerk something, you pull it suddenly and with a lot of force.
A jersey is a shirt worn by a member of a sports team showing their number.
A jest is a joke or something you say to make people laugh.
A jet is a fast airplane that is powered by jet engines.
A jewel is a valuable stone, like a diamond or ruby, used to make jewelry.
A jeweler is a professional who makes, repairs, or sells expensive watches and rings.
Jewelry refers to beautiful ornaments like necklaces and rings that people wear.
A jigsaw is a puzzle made of hundreds of small, oddly shaped pieces that fit together.
A jingle is a short, catchy song used in television or radio advertisements.
If objects jingle, they make a light ringing sound when they hit each other.
Your job is the regular work that you do to earn money.
If someone is jobless, they do not have a job and are unemployed.
A jockey is a professional rider who races horses in competitions.
If you jog, you run slowly and steadily as a form of physical exercise.
A jogger is a person who regularly runs slowly for exercise.
Jogging is the activity of running at a slow, steady pace for your health.
If you join a group or club, you become an official member of it.
A joint is a place in your body, like your knee, where two bones connect and bend.
If a project is joint, it is owned or done together by two or more people.
If people act jointly, they do something together as a unified team.
A joke is a short, funny story that you tell to make people laugh.
If you joke, you say funny things that are not meant to be taken seriously.
A joker is a person who loves telling jokes and making others laugh.
A jolt is a sudden, violent physical shock or bump.
If something jolts you, it shakes you violently and unexpectedly.
If people jostle you, they push and bump against you in a crowded space.
A journal is a written record of your daily thoughts, activities, and experiences.
Journalism is the profession of investigating and reporting the news for newspapers or television.
A journalist is a professional whose job is to write news reports for the media.
A journey is a long trip from one place to another.
If you journey, you travel a very long distance to reach a destination.
If someone is jovial, they are cheerful, friendly, and always smiling.
Joy is an emotion of extreme happiness and deep pleasure.
If an event is joyful, it makes you feel extremely happy and excited.
If an occasion is joyous, it is full of deep happiness and celebration.
A judge is an official who decides how criminals should be punished in a court of law.
If you judge someone, you form an opinion about their character or behavior.
Your judgment is your ability to make sensible decisions after thinking carefully.
Judicial means relating to the legal system, the courts, and the judges.
Judo is a Japanese sport where you try to throw your opponent to the ground.
A jug is a large container with a handle used for holding and pouring liquids.
If you juggle, you keep throwing and catching several objects in the air at once.
A juggler is an entertainer who throws objects into the air and catches them repeatedly.
Juice is the sweet, healthy liquid that you squeeze out of fruits and vegetables.
If a fruit is juicy, it is deliciously full of liquid when you bite into it.
July is the seventh month of the year, occurring during the summer in the northern hemisphere.
If you jumble things, you mix them up into an untidy, disorganized pile.
If something is jumbo, it is much larger than the normal size.
If you jump, you push yourself suddenly up into the air using your legs.
A jump is the sudden movement you make when you push yourself off the ground.
In British English, a jumper is a warm piece of clothing like a sweater.
If you feel jumpy, you are very nervous and easily frightened by sudden noises.
A junction is a place where two or more roads or railway lines meet.
June is the sixth month of the year, known for the beginning of summer.
A jungle is a wild, tropical forest filled with thick trees and dangerous animals.
If a worker is junior, they have a lower rank or position in the company.
A junior is a young person or someone who is less experienced in a job.
Junk refers to old, broken, or completely useless things that should be thrown away.
Jurisdiction is the official legal right to make decisions or arrests in a specific area.
A juror is a regular citizen who sits in a courtroom to help decide a legal case.
A jury is a group of twelve people who listen to a court case and decide if a person is guilty.
If a decision or law is just, it is morally right and fair to everyone.
You use just to say that something happened a very short time ago.
Justice is the fair treatment of people according to the rules of the law.
If an action is justifiable, there is a very good and acceptable reason for doing it.
A justification is a good reason or explanation for why you did something.
If you justify your actions, you give a good reason to prove you were right.
If someone is treated justly, they are treated fairly and with respect.
Juvenile crimes or behaviors are committed by teenagers or children under eighteen.
If you juxtapose things, you place them side by side to contrast their differences.
